name: HEX to RGB
summary: Convert HEX colors to RGB and HSL — instantly in your browser.
description: Paste a hex or rgb() color to see HEX, short HEX, RGB channels, and HSL. Includes a color picker and one-click copy for each format.

faqs.question: Can I paste rgb()?
faqs.answer: Yes. rgb(r, g, b) and rgba(...) (alpha ignored for conversion) are supported.

faqs.question: Is my color uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
